international.title: ‘Mass-casualty event’ in Europe possible amid rise in Russian sabotage, says thinktank
international.summary: Report warns attacks on critical infrastructure could lead to demand for retaliation and expose EU divisions Russian sabotage attacks on Europe are increasing and a “mass-casualty event” is now possible as increasingly skilled operatives target critical infrastructure with ever more complex methods, a leading strategic thinktank has said. The International Institute for Strategic Studies (IISS) said in a report that Russian intelligence services and their proxies were targeting European railways, energy networks and defence industries in an attempt to weaken support for Ukraine.
